retention.explain: Keeps the {last} newest backups of each target, plus the newest of each of the last {daily} days, {weekly} weeks and {monthly} months. Older ones are deleted after each run.

plan.emptyText: A plan names what to back up (sites, databases, folders), where to keep the backups and how many.
plan.keepLocal: Also keep the backups on this server
plan.noStorage: To copy backups off this server, add a bucket on the Storage tab.
plan.recipientsHint: age public keys ("age1…"), one per line. Make a key pair elsewhere with "age-keygen -o key.txt"; enter only the public key here.
plan.keyWarning: The panel never stores the private keys (AGE-SECRET-KEY-1…). Keep them safe and away from this server: without one, encrypted backups can never be restored.
plan.encryptSuggest: The backups will be copied to a bucket unencrypted. Adding an age public key is strongly recommended.
plan.deleteText: The plan is deleted. Its backups are kept unless you choose otherwise.
plan.deleteFiles: Also delete its backups, here and in the bucket
plan.deleteTextFiles: The plan and all its backups, here and in the bucket, are deleted.
plan.recipientCount: Encrypted for {count} key | Encrypted for {count} keys
plan.sheetIntro: What to back up, where to keep it and how many backups to keep.
plan.adminOnly: This plan backs up folders outside the site directories. Only accounts that may open those folders in the file manager can save it.

runs.empty: The plan has not run yet.

storage.intro: S3-compatible buckets that backup plans copy to. The secret key is kept encrypted and never shown again.

hint.aws: Endpoint s3.REGION.amazonaws.com with the bucket's region.
hint.r2: Endpoint ACCOUNT_ID.r2.cloudflarestorage.com; region "auto". Use an R2 API token's access key and secret.
hint.oss: Endpoint oss-REGION.aliyuncs.com (for example oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com); region without "oss-".
hint.cos: Endpoint cos.REGION.myqcloud.com; the bucket name ends with your APPID (name-1250000000).
hint.minio: Your MinIO host and port; turn on path style. Use plain HTTP only on a trusted local network.
hint.other: The host name (and port) of the S3 API, without https:// and without the bucket.

storage.insecureWarning: Without HTTPS, keys and backups travel unprotected. Use it only on a trusted local network.
storage.testOk: The bucket can be reached with these settings.
storage.deleteText: Only the settings are deleted; backups already in the bucket stay there.
storage.emptyText: Add an S3-compatible bucket to keep copies of the backups off this server.
storage.sheetIntro: An S3-compatible bucket. The secret key is kept encrypted and never shown again.
storage.adminOnly: Plans that back up folders outside the site directories keep their backups here: only accounts that may open those folders in the file manager can change this storage.

drawer.noTasks: No scheduled task runs this plan; it runs only by hand.
